items.text: Strategy bought 1,665 BTC for $142.7M (avg ~$85,681), funded by MSTR at-the-market sales, taking holdings to a record 847,666 BTC.
STRC’s dividend rate stays at 12.00% for October; a shareholder vote on daily dividends for the preferreds is set for Oct 28.
Strive (ASST) reached 27,462 BTC, and its SATA preferred holds a 13.00% rate for October.
